cautions: The 3 hours to 45 minutes figure is teacher-reported. Say teachers reported it.
EdWeek says up to three hours and about 45 minutes per student. Do not call 45 minutes the norm for every teacher.
Use 52 campuses and over 36,000 students from the district, or say about 36,000.
The tool flags trends and highlights blank template fields. It does not decide interventions or eligibility. Never show it writing or deciding the IEP alone.
Basham, Coleman, Vance and the CDT survey are national context, not about Mesquite.
Mesquite did not notify families separately and Vance recommends disclosure with an opt-out. A disagreement, not wrongdoing.
The Panorama post is vendor marketing.
